name: Journey: a lifted creature stands by its place in its zone, inside the window around the character
contract: Requires mod-coa-content-scaling with CoAContentScaling.Enable=1, Progression.Mode=Journey, TBC.Enable=1 and WotLK.Enable=1 at the default journey shape, and CoA.CreatureScaling.Enable=0 (conf/verify-all-scaling.json). Also DestinyWeaver.Enable=1 and DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1 with CoAContentScaling.Journey.Window.* at 1, 2, 2. Elwynn Forest opens at 1. A level-1 creature stands at the bottom of the zone, so it is shown two levels below a character who chose scaling: 57 to a level-59 character, 28 to a level-30 one. A level-10 creature stands at the top, so it is shown two above: 61 to a level-59 character - the offset rule alone would show it at 55. Without the choice the creature keeps its own level.

steps.label: Without the choice the creature keeps its own level
The zone's lowest creature stands two below a level-59 character
The zone's highest creature stands two above a level-59 character
The zone's lowest creature stands two below a level-30 character
